title: VNet peering health check
description: Monitors VNet peering connections for status issues, disconnected peerings, or asymmetric configurations.
example_prompt: "List all VNet peerings across subscriptions. Check: (1) peering status (Connected/Disconnected/Initiated), (2) both sides exist and are connected, (3) gateway transit settings are symmetric, (4) address space overlaps. Flag any peering not in 'Connected' state or with misconfigured transit."
